description: Land Title Settlement Department - An amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2075/07 of 11.06.2018, Cad. Map No. 520008, Homagama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of land title registration for a specific parcel of land (No. 205 of Block 16) in Maththegoda, including changes to parcel number and land extent measurements. It falls under the Land Registration Act and is published in the "PART III - LANDS" section, making it clearly a land and property-related matter that fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
